newsitem.title: HUNGARY: RICHTER, TVK AT HIGHS IN LONDON.
newsitem.headline: RICHTER, TVK AT HIGHS IN LONDON.

text.p: Global Depositary Receipts (GDRs) in Hungarian pharmaceuticals Richter and chemicals firm TVK surged to new record highs in London's SEAQ in early trade after they released their first half earnings reports.
Later, however, profit-taking has started to trim their prices, traders said.
Richter surged to a new high of $99.5 and at 0854 GMT it was marked at $98, up $1.875.
TVK also jumped to a new high of $22.175 from which it retreated to $21.75 at 0854 GMT, up $0.5.
Share trading on the Budapest Stock Exchange has not started yet but traders expect both stocks to move higher.
Richter reported its IAS net profit rising to 9.507 billion forints in the first six months of 1997 from 6.527 billion forints in the same period of 1996.
TVK reported an unconsolidated first half net income of 8.016 billion forints compared to 5.350 billion in the same six months of 1996.
